definitions.explanation: A person in the same class at school. Borrowed from English 'classmate.'

examples.japanese: クラスメート⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧クラスメート⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I got in touch with a high school classmate after a long time.

examples.japanese: クラスメート⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄|よ}せ{書|が}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided as a class to give the teacher a signed message board.

notes:
A loanword from English 'classmate,' used for students in the same class at school. Typically refers to the same homeroom class rather than just taking the same course.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クラスメート⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to be on good terms with classmates
- クラスメート⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧: to consult a classmate
- ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧クラスメート: former classmate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同級生|どうきゅうせい}→同級生：03032_doukyuusei⟧: classmate (same grade/year) — broader than クラスメート; includes all students in the same school year, not just the same class
- ⟦{学友|がくゆう}→学友：27117_gakuyuu⟧: school friend — more literary; emphasizes friendship rather than just being in the same class
